description:
Universal high-speed download manager, 8K video extractor, and BitTorrent workstation for Windows.

Vortex Downloader is an all-in-one download manager, video extractor, and BitTorrent client for Windows 11.
It unifies 32-stream multi-threaded download acceleration, 8K 60fps HDR video capture from over 1,800 sites, built-in sequential torrent streaming, in-app media player, and automatic Windows Defender security scanning.
Vortex Downloader v1.1.3 Release:
- Added full support for TeraBox and 16+ mirror domains.
- Multi-threaded parallel stream acceleration (up to 32 connections).
- Built-in sequential torrent streaming and 8K HDR playback engine.
- Automated Windows Defender antivirus inspection on all completed files.
- Full Chrome and Firefox extension integration.
